1937, April
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 180 Cont.
Apr. 7 James Madigan - 10 - Brain tuomer operated a week ago, getting worse so far. Enrolled To-day
Kenneth Keogh - 4 - of Dashwood, Ont. - could not speak - was en- rolled in Ser. Mass now "talks like a whirlwind" ....
10 5P.M. - Elden Carl Johnson - 3 of Presbiterian Ch. - mastoid yes- terday - blood transfusion To-day, only child.
Kenneth Carol1 - 8 - adopted - had bitterly biased step-father ... O.K .... looked on as miracle.
Page 181
Apr. 10 James D. Dunn - 69 - Thanksgiving - infection - complication -Drs. expected him to pass away before end of March. On his feed again and very hopeful - Dr.B .-
John Shea - 22 - blood-poison in foot. ..
Joseph Siebert - Eloise recovering wants to come home
Nich Lauer - 27 years in St. Jos. Re. - wall caved in on him and had to be sent thither
Rev. Fr. Heltner - about 50 - in St. Jos. Ret. poorly ....
Mary Nolan - 13 - of Fr. Wayne ....
13 Frank Vercammen - 25 - T.B. - operation feared to be necessary .... Eliz. Newcom - 16 - Gland trouble T.B .???
Page 182 Apr. 14 Mrs. Matild Patrikus - 64 - gall stones ...
Mrs. Rose McConachie - 57 - fears cancer
19 22 Mrs. Marjorie Gamble - 36 - non Cath. - intestinal trouble - had ten operations: - hopes to escape any more.
Marg. Patrcia McManus - 5 - arthritis two yrs. - lame and some- times quite helpless
23 Mary Betyn, Long - 22 - ran away from home two weeks after graduat- ing (Catholic School Nativity) married a baptist .... When about to be confined first time declared to the Catholic Chaplin: I am not Cath- olic and never was. She lives only two blks from home with husband and two children. She meets her mother but never addresses her or speaks of her as mother ....
